acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, IArobo.ai is completely free. No registration required. Simply paste your suspicious content and get instant AI analysis.

mainEntity.name: What types of scams does IArobo detect?

acceptedAnswer.text: IArobo detects phishing, fake banking messages, fake job offers, romance scams, investment fraud, fake cryptocurrency schemes, identity theft, blackmail, and marketplace fraud.
Yes, IArobo fully supports Arabic, English, and French for both input content and AI analysis output.

mainEntity.name: Can I upload WhatsApp screenshots to check for scams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. IArobo accepts image uploads and uses OCR technology to extract text from screenshots automatically, then analyzes it for fraud indicators.

mainEntity.name: How accurate is IArobo scam detection?

acceptedAnswer.text: IArobo achieves over 99% accuracy on known scam patterns using a large language model trained on millions of fraud examples.
